instagram_sends.action: Almost nobody DMs these Reels. Sends are Instagram's strongest non-follower signal: end on one surprising, quotable fact a viewer would send to a specific friend, not a generic wrap-up line.

cadence_reason: Average retention is 57% of the required bar. More uploads of a format that loses viewers early just teaches the feed to stop showing the channel. Ship one strong video a day until retention clears the gate.
